- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:458-465 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_blocked_stale_clear(), the post-loop `emit("kept", "cap_not_pr_target", ...)` runs and exits via SystemExit before the `cap_marker_out_of_window` check, so when `not_pr_target` is set and `totalCount > len(nodes)` the log reports cap_not_pr_target even though a PR-labeling cap may sit outside the newest-100 window.
  WHY: The label is still kept, so the decision is safe, but the REVIEW_BLOCKED_STALE_CLEAR reason operators triage on is misleading on long threads, and no test covers the combined linked-issue cap plus totalCount > 100 case; sonnet, minimax and glm rated it NIT and gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:436 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `body.startswith(CAP_PREFIX)` is a case-sensitive match against `**AI review/autofix stopped`.
  WHY: A future workflow edit that capitalises the header or adds a banner above it could silently disable cap recognition and stop stale-clear from removing labels; gemini gave no severity, so low is a placeholder; minimax raised this only as a hardening suggestion; sonnet and glm declined it because test_pr_target_wording_matches_the_cap_writer pins the header.

  WHY: The label is kept, so the decision is correct, but the diagnostic is misleading on long PR threads and no test covers a linked-issue cap with total_count > 100. Hardening suggestion: move the totalCount window check above the not_pr_target emit, or add a test in tests/test_review_blocked_stale_clear.py that combines _cap_comment(target=ISSUE_TARGET_LINE) with total_count=250 (4-8 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
